root_cause.text: The error handling paths in the `ice_set_ringparam()` function of the ice driver lack proper cleanup labels to free previously allocated `xdp_rings` and `tx_rings` when `rx_rings` allocation or setup fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that when `rx_rings` allocation fails, the code previously executed `goto done;` (leaking both `tx_rings` and `xdp_rings`), and when Rx ring setup fails, it executed `goto free_tx;` (leaking `xdp_rings`). The fix introduces a new `free_xdp` label to clean up `xdp_rings` and updates the error paths to jump to it.
